title: Focused 16-row held-source owner reconciliation — author audit
status: Provisional AI editorial decisions; independent AI peer review pending. No human approval or release claim.
method: Compared exact DOCX inventory examples and meaning notes with selected owner briefs, assessed constructions, and live target patterns. Re-lemmas retain the exact original expression in each decision and source occurrence. Only the selected reusable embedded unit routes to an owner.

rows.originalExpression: engine that keeps modern work from grinding to a halt
rows.exactSourceExample: Clear communication is the engine that keeps modern work from grinding to a halt.
rows.reason: The source contains the reusable stop-completely unit “grinding to a halt”; its engine clause is a bespoke frame. Owner 2443 teaches the same full-stop sense and its bounded detector matches the complete source sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.originalExpression: starting point, not a final command
rows.exactSourceExample: Treat the suggestion as a starting point, not a final command.
rows.reason: The source contrasts an initial basis with a final command. Owner 2273 teaches the same initial-not-final learner decision and its detector matches the full sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.exactSourceExample: Reliable deliveries help businesses keep moving.
rows.reason: Reliable deliveries help businesses continue functioning. Owner 2400 teaches this continuation sense and its detector matches the full sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.exactSourceExample: Do not give up at once after a mistake.
rows.reason: After a mistake, “at once” means immediately, not simultaneous actions. Owner 3142 teaches immediate-after-trigger and matches the full sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.exactSourceExample: The picture caught her attention at once.
rows.reason: The picture caught attention immediately. Owner 3142 teaches this immediate sense rather than the simultaneous-actions sense of 048 and matches the full sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.originalExpression: advertising shapes attention before it shapes decisions
rows.exactSourceExample: The study suggests advertising shapes attention before it shapes decisions about brands.
rows.reason: The study says advertising influences attention and brand decisions. Canonical 020 teaches this influence sense of shape; its bounded inflection detector matches both “shapes” tokens in the full sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.exactSourceExample: Short projects can be stepping stones to a new career.
rows.reason: Short projects as stepping stones toward a career are enabling intermediate experiences, the same goal-progress sense as legacy canonical 009. Its bounded target now covers singular and plural noun forms and matches the complete source sentence. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.
rows.legacySourceMetadata: Legacy lessons have no sources array. Exact source provenance remains in the inventory and decision record.

rows.exactSourceExample: Investigators were working in the dark until the records arrived.
rows.reason: Working in the dark overlaps canonical 163 on lack of information but changes construction beyond its detector. Provisional editorial decision; independent review remains open.
rows.holdRationale: “Working in the dark” is an intransitive investigative construction; owner 163 teaches someone being left somewhat in the dark. Shared information-gap theme is insufficient to add a full new construction without owner redesign.

rows.exactSourceExample: You can dip in and out of the magazine over a week.
rows.reason: The source describes intermittent use of a magazine over a week, the same resource-use sense as canonical 1988. Its bounded detector now covers the explicit magazine object as well as “it”. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.

rows.exactSourceExample: Ethical rules must keep pace with human invention.
rows.reason: Keep pace with human invention shares existing pace idiom but owner restricts object to demand. Provisional editorial decision; independent review remains open.
rows.holdRationale: Owner 590 tests provision keeping up with demand; ethical rules adapting to invention has a broader regulatory subject/object and requires a separate owner-scope decision.

rows.originalExpression: a small window to another culture
rows.exactSourceExample: Imported food can be a small window to another culture.
rows.reason: Hold: a small window to another culture may be a valid window-to variant of canonical 305 a window into, both describing insight or access. The preposition falls outside 305’s detector; resolve variant naturalness and owner scope before release.
rows.holdRationale: Owner 305 teaches “a window into/onto” and its current detector excludes “a window to”. Naturalness and preposition scope require evidence before expansion.

rows.exactSourceExample: The festival decided to lean into its local character.
rows.reason: Hold: deliberate embrace or emphasis in lean into a festival may be covered by prior general lean-into lesson 1687; healthy habits may only be its example object. Compare contexts and decide broaden-versus-split before authoring. Provisional; independent human review open.
rows.holdRationale: Owner 1687 is a wellbeing-routine lesson; leaning into a festival’s local character broadens the object and learner decision beyond existing assessed content.

rows.originalExpression: growth often walks them through it
rows.exactSourceExample: Evidence may open the door, but growth often walks them through it.
rows.reason: The source’s “growth walks them through it” is bespoke personification; “open the door” is the reusable opportunity unit. Canonical 028 covers that opportunity sense and matches the full source. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.
rows.boundedTargetPattern: (?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) (?:the|a) door(?:s)?\b|\bthe door (?:is|was) opening wider\b)|(?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) the academic door\b)

rows.originalExpression: changed behaviour is what walks through it
rows.exactSourceExample: An apology opens the door, but changed behaviour is what walks through it.
rows.reason: Changed behaviour walking through a door is bespoke personification; the apology “opens the door” to reconciliation. Canonical 028 teaches creating an opportunity and matches the full source. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.
rows.boundedTargetPattern: (?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) (?:the|a) door(?:s)?\b|\bthe door (?:is|was) opening wider\b)|(?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) the academic door\b)

rows.originalExpression: market decides whether anyone actually walks through it
rows.exactSourceExample: The idea may open a door, but the market decides whether anyone actually walks through it.
rows.reason: The market walking through a door is bespoke personification; the idea may “open a door” to an opportunity. Canonical 028 teaches creating an opportunity and matches the full source. Provisional editorial decision; independent AI review pending.
rows.boundedTargetPattern: (?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) (?:the|a) door(?:s)?\b|\bthe door (?:is|was) opening wider\b)|(?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) the academic door\b)

rows.exactSourceExample: A long journey can take the shine off it.
rows.reason: Take the shine off it matches canonical 1839 enjoyment-loss sense but its it object is outside the trip-specific detector. Provisional editorial decision; independent review remains open.
rows.holdRationale: “It” lacks an explicit antecedent in the source sentence, so the object may be the journey, destination or expectation; owner 1839 is trip-specific. Hold until source referent is resolved.
